The Winged Tiger When villains 'Winged Tiger' Teng Fei and 'Underworld King' Yin Te Lung unite, the martial arts world is plunged into chaos. Can this deadly duo be stopped?
Torrent of Desire Flames of lust burn strongly in this high-octane melodrama that stars Jenny Hu, Yang Fan and Qiao Zhuang.
Hex After Hex In this comedy, hellish emotions are unleashed when a demon arranges to have his true love killed in order to possess her. Starring Lo Meng.
Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty Emperor Chien Lung woos a famous courtesan, indulges in some gambling and helps out earthquake victims while incognito in Suzhou.
The Kung-fu Instructor In The Kung-fu Instructor, Ti Lung plays hero Huang Yang, a righteous weapon instructor whose main concern eventually becomes his survival.
The 82 Tenants If you liked House of 72 Tenants, you won't want to miss out on this humorous, fun-filled sequel complete with 10 more tenants!
The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter Martial arts greats Lau Kar Leung and Alexander Fu play out the vendetta of General Yang and the creation of the unique eight-diagram pole fight technique.
The Twin Bracelets Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.
Reincarnated Swordsman In this saga of warring clans, revenge and the ultimate martial arts skills, Yun, a young swordsman, battles the odds to avenge his father's death.
Diary of a Lady-killer A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.
Vengeance Is a Golden Blade In this tale of greed, lust and vengeance, only Silver Swallow can stop the golden blade.
The Mirror and the Lichee The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.
The Golden Buddha A ruthless gang goes up against a millionaire's daughter who has one of three priceless Golden Buddha statues.
Na Cha the Great A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.
Super Inframan A superhero (Danny Lee) must save the earth from legions of demons and monsters led by a blonde-haired Demon Princess.
The Yellow Muffler This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.
The Deadly Knives Two lovers who return to announce their marriage plans discover that their families are in conflict over land. Can they mend this broken bond?
The Perfumed Arrow A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.
Princess Iron Fan In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.
Buddha's Palm This new adaptation of the most powerful martial arts form is a cult classic for all fans. Witness breathtaking special effects.
Hex Vs Witchcraft After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.
Shaolin Martial Arts When the Emperor employs Manchu boxers to eradicate the Shao Lin martial artists, see how two escapees begin a quest to restore the reputation of Shao Lin.
Till the End of Time A singer struggles against the odds to keep her career and marriage intact. Starring Jenny Hu, Peter Chen Ho.
The Knight of Knights In seeking to avenge his six comrades' murders, a swordsman must battle against Qiao Qing Monastery's notorious monks.
The Merry Wife Jealousy threatens to expose the secret relationship of a 17-year-old student and her 35-year-old teacher husband.
Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung An old grudge between the families of the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung, finally draws a young man back to avenge his father's death.
River of Tears This tragic tale depicts the life of Fang Pi Yu, a singer whose husband dies in his attempt to free her from her past, and whose father-in-law throws her out.
What Price Honesty Pai Piao, Danny Lee and 'Venom's' Sun Chien play idealistic police graduates who run afoul of powerful, corrupt individuals in this farsighted film.
Come Drink With Me King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.
Mission Impossible While returning the stolen Golden Sword to the palace, a sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master, only to return as a spirit to take revenge against the evildoer.
The Empress Dowager Lisa Lu stars as the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty in this film that is full of palace intrigues and power games.
The Lark 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star 'Little Lark' in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.
The Twelve Gold Medallions Loyal to the emperor, the protagonist attempts to stop the delivery of a message depicted across twelve gold medallions that is to be delivered by traitors.
The Venus' Tear Diamond Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.
The Proud Youth This fascinating story of conflicting clans marks the beginning of Sun Chung's exploration of the kung fu genre.
The Shadow Boxing Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.
Marco Polo Directed by the legendary Chang Cheh, this rousing tale presents a fictional account of the famous Italian explorer's adventures.
Enchanting Shadow This seminal film adaptation of a 17th century Pu Songling work is the precursor of the famed 'A Chinese Ghost Story'.
A Taste of Cold Steel It's a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword, as the Five Tigers take this adventure to the outer limits.
The Scandalous Warlord According to this sex comedy, the true power behind China's many warlords were the prostitutes that these men would visit.
Have Sword Will Travel A drifter (David Chiang) and another swordsman (Ti Lung) are competitors for a woman's love who fate turns into brothers in arms.
Crocodile River Two students fall in love but their two families are enemies and separated by a river that is filled with crocodiles and beasts.
The Lady Hermit A pair of female martial artists end up banding together to go up against the evil Black Demon. Starring Cheng Pei Pei.
Brothers From the Walled City The lives of two very different brothers intertwine when they find themselves the target of a vengeful inspector.
Human Lanterns An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!
The Blue and the Black A young couple's love is put to the test over a tumultuous period of Chinese history. Starring Linda Lin Dai, Kwan Shan.
Whose Baby Is in the Classroom? Inoue Umetsugu's last Shaw film before his untimely death is a testament to the auteur's carefree comic talent.
The Five Venoms The dying master of the powerful Poison Clan dispatches his last pupil, Yang Tieh, on a crucial mission to atone for the evil deeds of his clan disciples.
Return of the Phoenix In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.
Rape of the Sword When a swordswoman falters in her attempt to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the world's sharpest blade, her protg continues her quest.
Love With the Perfect Stranger Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luk's directing debut.
The Swift Knight Lo Lieh finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.
Double Bliss Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.
The Duel of the Century Two men find more than they bargained for when they attempt to investigate the apparent murder of a swordsman.
Forever Diamonds Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another man's hands, she now has to get it back.
The Convict Killer Director Chor Yuan teams with star Ti Lung and famed novelist Chu Yu in the creation of this intriguing kung fu saga.
Born to Fly Headed by elite pilots, a special operations team is tasked to test new fighter jets. During test flights, the pilots face different difficulties and challenges, and try to push beyond their limits.
Where the Wind Blows Two notorious corrupt police officers, Detectives Lui Lok and Nam Kong were found to build a corruption network between the triad and police, the ICAC begins to hunt them down to end their control.
YUM Investigation A team of investigators was sent to an old building believed to be haunted by evil spirits, only to discover an unexpected secret concerning the future of the structure.
Hero Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.
The Phantom Lover It is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community!
Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.
Tristar A young priest striving to save lost souls crosses paths with a prostitute seeking refuge in the church to escape her debts, they get entangled in a CID investigation into a prostitution ring.
Golden Boy Fallen boxing star "Golden Boy" Chang Li, after a decade in prison, must reconnect with the son he has never met. He rediscovers his purpose and returns to the ring to become the father his son deserves.
American Girl During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.
Z Storm An ICAC investigator uncovers the huge fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the government's $15 billion 'Care Fund'. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.
8 Bucks Tycoon When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?
Love After Love Marking the 3rd Eileen Chang adaptation directed by Ann Hui, this film is set in pre-WW2 Hong Kong, where a young girl ends up working for her aunt seducing rich & powerful men.
Sifu VS Vampire In a selfish grasp at financial gain, a TV station tycoon intimidates a feng shui master into relocating his great grandfather's coffin - and pays the price.
Ready o/r Rot Guy and Heidi face pre-marital strife. Meanwhile, Grey Bear doubts his wife's fidelity and Ken faces a life crisis following his girlfriend's pregnancy. Can they resolve their relationship issues?
Bounty Hunters Five bounty hunters are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings plaguing a hotel group in Bangkok. Can they solve the crime and finally collect the bounty?
I Still Remember An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.
All's Well End's Well (Extended version) In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release
One Second In Zhang Yimou's screen gem that captures the power of cinema, a labour camp escapee seeks a newsreel that captures a one-second glimpse of his daughter. However, he has competition.
Beauty And The 7 Beasts To make a living, Teddy accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. His career regains momentum after reunites with his long-lost daughter.
The Unwavering Brotherhood Hua, Fei and Guo are robbed when transporting gang money. When Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.
Battle Of The Wolf A former special forces sergeant must protect his wife and fellow passengers aboard a hijacked plane, using his courage and tactical expertise to take down the terrorists and ensure everyone's safety.
Detrimental You Ji Ren is a visually impaired factory worker living in an island. After a hurricane cut them off from the outside world, a monster suddenly appears, turning whoever sees it into black shadows.
The Locksmith Hao Ren inherits the skills of Locksmith Shan and befriends Detective Liu who often seeks his help. When Hao Ren unveils the mystery of Shan's wife's disappearance one day, strange events ensue.
Operation Mekong Based on the Mekong River massacre, Zhang Han Yu & Eddie Peng star as members of a task force bent on bringing down a drug cartel, with Malaysia providing the backdrops for breath-taking action scenes.
The Narrow Road The owner of a small cleaning company, Chak, experiences a tough time during the pandemic. When he employs single mother Candy as his assistant, she became his saving grace.
The Dumpling Queen In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters after a failed marriage. She builds a dumpling stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises to become the city's renowned "Dumpling Queen".
Ghost Wedding A photographer becomes entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives. When the girl he likes dies mysteriously, he uncovers the secret of a 'ghost marriage'.
Love Never Ends Two elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!
Legend of the Fist:The Return of Chen Zhen As Japan's grip on China tightens, Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai to infiltrate the notorious Club Casablanca, whose owner is a Japanese collaborator.
Look Up Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.
Out of Order A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.
Over My Dead Body When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.
Turns We Take A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.
Flying Swords of Dragon Gate Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.
Last Suspect A lawyer must defend a murder suspect and win the case in order to save her daughter who has been taken hostage. As evidence emerges, she unveils the truth and the man behind the case.
To Live And Die in Mongkok Disoriented and trapped in notorious, vice-ridden Mongkok, a once-feared triad figure struggles to adapt to life in the wake of his 30-year prison sentence.
Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.
Coffin Homes Three tales merges in this satire set against Hong Kong's housing crisis, where soaring property prices have driven people to desperate measures - including sharing a space with the dead!
Endgame A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.
Red Line A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.
God of Gambler's Return A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.
Operation Hadal Deep-sea special forces and the submarine 'Long Jing' join forces to stop an international super-submarine conspiracy, battling through enemy ambushes and treacherous depths in a thrilling showdown.
The Sorcerer and the White Snake Charlene Choi & Eva Huang star as beautiful snake demons who venture into the human world, incurring the wrath of Jet Li's authoritarian monk.
Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.
Stand Up Story Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.
The Invisible Guest Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.
Flashover Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.
Bodyguards and Assassins Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.
Sons of the Neon Night In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

The Unicorns Have Got To Go/It's Time/Under The Hood/K.I.L.I.T. Radio/Thomas Fights Back Mordecai buys a new cologne
Freaky Gwen Ben/This One Goes To 11/Omni-Copped/I Don't Like You/Something I Ate Ben interferes with malicious magician Hex's quest for the Titan Gloves at a flea market and accidentally switches bodies with Gwen, forcing him to walk a mile in her shoes and vice-versa!
The Gods Must Be Goosey/Cowboy Courage/Tulip's Worm/Night of the Scarecrow/Cajun Granny Stew A lonely goose god looks down from the heavens, and spying Muriel, decides she must be his queen.
Free Cake/Really Real Wrestling/Cool Bikes/Last Meal/Every Meat Burritos Our heroes want some cake
Mock 10/Bounty Ball/Fear The Fogg/Super-Villain Team-Up/Summer Breakers Ben, Kevin and LaGrange get stuck "outside of time".
The Power Of Shrimps Aqualad uses shrimp and prime rib to win back Raven.
Dr Lamput/Arm Wrestling After a mishap involving a bucket of grey paint, Lamput ends up back at the Lab, working undercover as the newest Doc on the block.
Well Deserved/Program On Demand/Frosty Cup/Choco Granito/Quick Meal/Digital Taming/Glacial Carrot The Lemmings and Grizzy collide with Santa's sled, while fighting. The Lemmings find Santa's magic bag.
Gadget Kid/The Visitor/The Big Tv/Keyboard Capers/A Running Battle High-tech wizardry and low-tech cunning get Mr Bean out of a jam.
Basketbugs Porky Pig puts a spin on ice skating.
Wish Bone Butch finds a wish bone in the garbage and dupes Tom.
The Siren's Song/Stuck/Lamput & The Ducklings Specs and Lamput team up to rescue Skinny from sirens.
Scratchy Wool/Wolf In Unicorn’S Clothing/Keep Off The Grass Trico thinks Wanda has lice and makes the whole flock panic.
The Dress/The Laziest/The Ghost/The Mystery/The Prank Gumball goes to school in a dress and becomes the darling of Elmore High.

Tuckered Boys/Spooky Boo (Halloween) Jeff is planning to wake up early for the meteor shower.
The Mustache/The Date Gumball and Darwin's wish comes true when they suddenly turn into men.
The Astrological/The Cheerleader Gumball and Penny defy fate, staying together all day.
Precious Plant/Bin & Gone/Staycation/Funfair/Grandfather Clock Mr Bean waters a plant—what could go wrong?
Mt. Neverest Porky and Daffy climb Mt. Neverest.
The Ghouls/The Bffs/The Agent/The Decisions/The Web Halloween isn't what it used to be. Can Gumball and Darwin help the ghouls get their "scare" back?
Real Date/Tent Trouble Mordecai and Cloudy J want to go on a romantic date.
Dreams/Grandma Voice After an exciting night of crime fighting, the Titans go to sleep and each one has unique dreams.

Snow Day/Why So Blue?/Prickly Pair Steven and the Crystal Gems get a chance to catch up when they’re all snowed in together.
Free Cake/Appreciation Day/Weekend At Benson's/Carter And Briggs/Catching The Wave Our heroes want some cake
The Clocktopus/Steam Fight At The Ok Corral/Adrenaland Jr./You Remind Me Of Someone/Cutting Corners In a peaceful coastal town, Ben must not only face the archaic antagonist Steam Smythe and his latest creation - the Clocktopus - but also his deepest, darkest fear: squid!
Queen of the Black Puddle/Evil Weevil/Mondo Magic/Watch The Birdies/Shadow of Courage After a rainstorm, a puddle queen materializes at the farm. She woos Eustace into her puddle world. Muriel is heartbroken, so Courage must save him.

Justice League's Next Top Talent Idol Star: Second Greatest Team Edition: Part 2 The competition heats up and Robin tries everything to win.
Transfer Gun/Super Docs The Boss invents a brain-swapping ray. Clever stuff. You know what’s not so clever? Accidentally using it on yourself.
Evil Spirit The Lemmings decide to free a spirit and send it to Grizzy in revenge for stealing their cartoon moment.

Knock, Knock…/Trico Where Are You?/A Puzzling Game Trico puts up a door thinking it will protect the flock…
The Gi/The Kiss/The Party/The Refund/The Robot Gumball and Darwin love the way they look in their new karate outfits and vow never to take them off.
Double Trouble/In The Wild/Missing Teddy/No Parking/Bean's Bounty Mr Bean meets a soul mate.

Plastic Bottle Royale While searching for plastic bottles for their class project, Amato and friends meet a recycling robot made from plastic.
Water Park/Where The Wild Chads Are The trio heads to Squirty's Moist Mountain water park.
The Club/The Wand When Gumball rejects "The Rejects Club", the rejects wreak their revenge.
The Boring/The Teacher Gumball and Darwin use time-stop to dodge Tina’s beatdown.
The New Dress/Wicket's Driving Lesson/Prize Photo/Scrapper's Snack/Movie Mayhem Mr Bean must protect a pricey dress he plans to return.
Looney Tunes Cartoons Back To School Special Daffy, Foghorn Leghorn and Beaky all learn lessons.
The Inquisition/The Sucker/The Cage/The Rival/The One School Superintendent Evil is coming to Elmore Junior High to stamp out all cartoonish conduct!
Bachelor Party! Zingo!!/Laundry Woes Skips must plan the perfect bachelor party for his cousin.
Real Magic/Puppets, Whaaaaat? Robin dabbles with magic, ignoring Raven's warning that he will anger the magic god.
Shhh/Crime Alert/Mani - Pedi/Not A Halloween Special/Chowda Titans must quietly return a gorilla to the zoo.
Happy Bouncy Fun Town The Bears land in the cheeriest place of all time, but Ice Bear starts to feel out of place.
Rattleballs/The Red Throne/Betty/Billy's Bucket List/Bad Timing Finn practices his sword fighting skills at the candy junkyard, where he meets an old gumball robot named Rattleballs.
In Dreams/Growing Pains/Mr. Universe Steven’s dreams start broadcasting onto his bedroom TV.
Death Punchies/Peeps/Fortune Cookie/Skips' Stress/Real Date Rigby is tired of losing at punchies

Everyone Wants to Direct A famous (zombie) film director comes to the farm, saying he wants to shoot his next film there. The greedy Farmer accepts when he is promised money.
Don/More Smarter/Rap It Up/Steak Me Amadeus/Wall Buddy Our heroes need help with the park
Funhouse/King Koil/The Charm Offensive/Double Hex/Rekoil The Tennysons are stuck inside an inescapable funhouse.
Nostalgia Is Not A Substitute For An Actual Story The Titans time travel back to the 1980s to determine whether or not it was the best decade ever.
Skinny's Dance Night/Lamput Checks In Ahead of the big dance, Skinny practices his moves so hard that he knocks himself out. Enter a very orange guardian angel.
Winning Tokens/Game Of Marbles/Five-Star Bowl/Lost Object/Crab Crush/Pirates In Sight/Crab Basket The Lemmings have set up a mini-fair but Grizzy steals the Lemmings' tickets in order to hit the jackpot

Dances With Wolf/Playing With Pacifier/Mindful Treasure Hunt Wolf uses his fabulous dancing skills to monopolize Wanda.

Home Movie/Fish Sitting/The Cruise/Coconut Shy/Green Bean Mr Bean makes his own horror movie.
Bro, Where's The Batmobile?/White Elephant/Ruler's Rule/Hero Hotline/Elseworlds Birdarang and Batarang retrace steps to find the Batmobile.

The Big Petey Pizza Problem/Break Up Jeff has everything in place for his birthday.

The App/The Letter Gumball and Darwin battle an app turning kids into drones.
Ghost Spotters/Necklace Thief/The Big Shrink/Winning Ticket/Train Trouble Mr. Bean rigs his flat to look haunted for a TV show.
Red, White And Bruised Porky tries Daffy Duck’s new jet pack.

Maxin' And Relaxin'/New Bro On Campus Mordecai wants to get a mix tape from his parents' house.

Temple Bears/Lighthouse/Doll's House/The Little Fallen Star The Bears search for a house key in a puzzle-filled temple.
Wake Up/Escape from the Citadel/Food Chain/James II/The Tower In order to find Finn's father, Finn and Jake must commit a cosmic crime...Unless the Lich beats them to it!
Fragments/Homeworld Bound/Everything's Fine Steven heads to the woods to train with a powerful mentor.
The Shopping Badge Duggee loves to shop local, so the Big Shop is a Big Deal for him. He's over-excited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him 'we only popped in for milk!'
The Love Badge When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.
The Rollercoaster Badge The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!
The World Record The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...
The In Charge Badge What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.
Eugene's Animal Chorus Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!
Copy The King The Squirrels play Copy the King!
Animals The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.
Mysterious Milkshake More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.
Mystery Seeds When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!
Tiddly Phone Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po receive a call on the Tubby Phone. It's the Tiddlytubbies who ring to say hello, just before the Tubby Phone Dance.
Best Friend Song The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!
Bedroom Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.
Obstacle Course Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.
Promises Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.
Omelette Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.
Born Yesterday Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.
Shankar's Makeover There's a fancy dress competition on the railways and while Thomas and the others are excited, Shankar doesn't want to join in.
Nia and the Unfriendly Elephant Nia is excited about being asked to transport a new elephant to the animal park, but the animal is scared of steam trains.
James the Super Engine When James hears the children of Sodor talking about their latest comic book superhero, he imagines that he too can become a hero.
Go Jetter Heroes: Polar Explorers When Glitch and Kyan race to the south pole, Glitch's loyal Grimbots steal the pole's marker to help Glitch win.
Middle of the World City: Ecuador After hearing about how the Monument to the Equator in Ciudad Mitad del Mundo is in the wrong location, Glitch and his Glitchbots pretend to be the Go Jetters and move the monument onto the equator.
Solar Race: Australia Glitch's hopes of winning a solar-powered race across the Australian outback are foiled when he crashes the Glitchster in the middle of the night.
Mojo Draws the Line Mojo and Bo were supposed to paint fresh lines on the street. But when they get into a race with Tao, the paint goes in every direction, causing wild traffic chaos.
Stinkano Preston left an egg sandwich out for too long, and now its explosive smell is stinking up the whole town. Mojo and Bo need to evacuate everyone in Swoppiton before the eggy 'stinkplosion'!
Couch Potato Evil Pea tries to trap Supertato down the back of a sofa but falls in too. Luckily, they meet Raisin, who lives there with her buttons and knows the only way out.
Trolley Cruise Supertato, Carrot and Broccoli get free tickets to go on a luxurious trolley cruise, but it's actually a one-way ticket out of the supermarket from Evil Pea!
Hench Cobs Song It's tough being one of Evil Pea's hench cobs, so Corn and Cob have a song to tell us all about it.
Evil Pea's Freeze Dance Song Evil Pea has created her very on Freeze Dance song to trick the fruit and veggies into dancing with her, so she can freeze them for real!
Tatocar vs Evil Peamobile Song The Tatoteam have the Tatocar and Evil Pea has the Evil Peamobile. But which one of these machines is best? Carrot and Evil Pea have a song to decide.
The Obstacle Course Badge It's time for the annual Animal Obstacle Course Race- the animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. Duggee has his Obstacle Course badge, together with the squirrels they form a team and the fun begins.
The Spooky Badge The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. They can see that something has spooked the chickens, so they stop what they are doing to investigate. They come across several different items, such as ghostly white footprints, and then they spot a floating sheet. What is going on? The Squirrels will have to take the long way round if they want to catch whatever it is.
The Space Badge Duggee teaches the squirrels all about the stars, the planets and the Milky Way!
The Harvest Badge Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.
Eugene's Animal Chorus Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!
Copy The King The Squirrels play Copy the King!
Animals The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.
Mysterious Milkshake More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.
Mystery Seeds When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!
Teasing Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. As they recall all the times where he's been a Big Teaser, Dad argues that he was only just playing.
Asparagus Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table - they're not animals. But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyone's got a wild side.
Shaun Bluey and Bingo want a pet. To show them how much work they'd be in for, Dad gets to transform his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu with a taste for trouble.
Daddy Putdown When Mum goes out to a baby shower, Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine. But with Bluey missing Mum, Dad has to pull out all the games he knows to keep them entertained.
Andy and the Mountain Gorillas Andy, Jen and Scout head to Africa on a global adventure to explore Uganda's impenetrable forest. Their mission - to track down a new baby gorilla who's just learning how to climb and forage for himself.
Andy and the Sea Otters Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to California, on the west coast of America, in search of a sea otter mother and pup that are living in a busy boating marina.
Take Off Po collects lots of balloons and takes off into the air! Floating high above Teletubbyland, Po waves at Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-­Laa below. When the balloons pop, Po lands.
J Dee encourages a friend to say 'j', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We wear some jumpers, ride on a jumbo jet and see a jaguar in a jungle!
Cheesy Feet Messy thinks smelly socks and cheesy feet are brilliant! But when it's Lofty's feet that smell, it's a giant problem...
Pizzas Away Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?
Driving With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.
Pizza Girls Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.
The Carrot Badge The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.
The Midnight Badge Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?
Stick Together Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!
Ping Pong Penguins What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!
Cappadocia, Turkey A game of hide and seek threatens to topple the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia in Turkey.
Hotel Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them how to compromise.
Sticky Gecko Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.
Tradies Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.
Granny Mobile Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.
Andy and the Black Bear Cubs In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head to Alaska, America on a baby animal mission to help rescue some black bear cubs high up in a tree. Along the way, Andy meets a grumpy Arctic ground squirrel.
Peas Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have fun looking for peas with the Playtimers in their Pea Party game.
The Buddy Badge Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.
The Diplomacy Badge Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.
The Senses Badge Roly has lost his best potato but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses and earn their Senses Badge.
Go Jet Academy: Symbiosis Shrink Down Tala, Foz and Lars shrink down to insect-size to learn about the friendship between plants and animals, but they find themselves in big trouble when Glitch upsets a colony of ants.
Mission Manatee, USA The Go Jetters are in the Gulf of Mexico to learn about Manatees - peaceful water mammals that spend most of their time either sleeping or eating sea-grass - which could be why they're sometimes called sea-cows!
Yong Bao and the Tiger Yong Bao tells Thomas the story of how he cleverly diverted an accident, saving hundreds of passengers and was decorated for his bravery with a tiger emblem on his tender and a bright red coat of paint.
Tortoise Snooze When it is time for Tortoise to hibernate, Sarah and Duck help him find a quiet place to sleep.
Fast Slow Bungalow Flamingo and John give Sarah and Duck a tour of their house and invite them to play their favourite game...
Dinosaur The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.
Kite Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.
Penguins Live in Igloos Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.
It's Time to Celebrate Creole Day JoJo and Gran Gran call Great Gran Gran to sing her the new song that JoJo has learnt. While doing so, JoJo discovers it is Jounen Kweyol (Creole Day) in Saint Lucia. JoJo is very interested in learning Creole, so to celebrate Creole Day, Gran Gran teaches her some words. They call Great Gran Gran again, and JoJo performs the new version of the song she has learnt in Creole!
Explorers While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.
Phones Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!
Pavlova Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.
The Mountain Badge The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.
The Lost Property Badge The Squirrels have just got some new walkie-talkies and are having so much fun with them. Duggee calls the Squirrels to come for some blueberry juice, but as Tag is running, he trips over a car and falls through a secret door in the wall! Communicating through his walkie-talkie, Tag doesn't know where he is. He can see lots and lots of things around him but no one has any idea where this room is i
Say Cheese The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.
The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.
Grapefruit Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Grapefruit, dedicating the song "All My Friends" to the close pals who go with her everywhere.
Leek Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Leek, who won't let anything, not even the chilly conditions backstage, stop him from singing his song "Can't Hold Me Down".
Undercover Tomato Tomato paints himself green and goes undercover as a Mini Pea to discover how Evil Pea is firing them at Tato Tower. He makes an unexpected new Mini Pea friend.
Toy Aisle Trouble Evil Pea takes all the toys in the supermarket for herself and the Cobs to play with. Supertato climbs a big wall of boxes to try and get the toys back.

While doing so, JoJo discovers it is Jounen Kweyol (Creole Day) in Saint Lucia. JoJo is very interested in learning Creole, so to celebrate Creole Day, Gran Gran teaches her some words. They call Great Gran Gran again, and JoJo performs the new version of the song she has learnt in Creole!
Explorers While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.
Phones Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!
Pavlova Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.
The Mountain Badge The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.
The Lost Property Badge The Squirrels have just got some new walkie-talkies and are having so much fun with them. Duggee calls the Squirrels to come for some blueberry juice, but as Tag is running, he trips over a car and falls through a secret door in the wall! Communicating through his walkie-talkie, Tag doesn't know where he is. He can see lots and lots of things around him but no one has any idea where this room is i
Say Cheese The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.
The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.
Grapefruit Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Grapefruit, dedicating the song "All My Friends" to the close pals who go with her everywhere.
Leek Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Leek, who won't let anything, not even the chilly conditions backstage, stop him from singing his song "Can't Hold Me Down".
Undercover Tomato Tomato paints himself green and goes undercover as a Mini Pea to discover how Evil Pea is firing them at Tato Tower. He makes an unexpected new Mini Pea friend.
Toy Aisle Trouble Evil Pea takes all the toys in the supermarket for herself and the Cobs to play with. Supertato climbs a big wall of boxes to try and get the toys back.
Take Off Po collects lots of balloons and takes off into the air! Floating high above Teletubbyland, Po waves at Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-­Laa below. When the balloons pop, Po lands.
J Dee encourages a friend to say 'j', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We wear some jumpers, ride on a jumbo jet and see a jaguar in a jungle!
Cheesy Feet Messy thinks smelly socks and cheesy feet are brilliant! But when it's Lofty's feet that smell, it's a giant problem...
Pizzas Away Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?
Driving With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.
Pizza Girls Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.
The Carrot Badge The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.
The Midnight Badge Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?
Stick Together Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!
Ping Pong Penguins What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!
Cappadocia, Turkey A game of hide and seek threatens to topple the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia in Turkey.
Hotel Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them how to compromise.
Sticky Gecko Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.
Tradies Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.
Granny Mobile Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.
Andy and the Black Bear Cubs In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head to Alaska, America on a baby animal mission to help rescue some black bear cubs high up in a tree. Along the way, Andy meets a grumpy Arctic ground squirrel.
Peas Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have fun looking for peas with the Playtimers in their Pea Party game.
The Buddy Badge Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.
The Diplomacy Badge Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.
The Senses Badge Roly has lost his best potato but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses and earn their Senses Badge.
Go Jet Academy: Symbiosis Shrink Down Tala, Foz and Lars shrink down to insect-size to learn about the friendship between plants and animals, but they find themselves in big trouble when Glitch upsets a colony of ants.
Mission Manatee, USA The Go Jetters are in the Gulf of Mexico to learn about Manatees - peaceful water mammals that spend most of their time either sleeping or eating sea-grass - which could be why they're sometimes called sea-cows!
Yong Bao and the Tiger Yong Bao tells Thomas the story of how he cleverly diverted an accident, saving hundreds of passengers and was decorated for his bravery with a tiger emblem on his tender and a bright red coat of paint.
Tortoise Snooze When it is time for Tortoise to hibernate, Sarah and Duck help him find a quiet place to sleep.
Fast Slow Bungalow Flamingo and John give Sarah and Duck a tour of their house and invite them to play their favourite game...
Dinosaur The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.
Kite Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

Treasure Trail Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa‐Laa and Po follow a trail of flowers which leads them to some very special treasure.
K Dee encourages a friend to say 'k', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see some kittens, fly some kites and meet a kind kangaroo!
Colours Messy and friends are left feeling blue when the vacubots suck all the colour out of OKIDO!
Piggyin the Riddle Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?
Tina Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.
Driving With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.
The Face Painting Badge The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.
The Carrot Badge The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.
Ready Or Not Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!
Stick Together Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!
Maasai Mara National Park, Kenya The team roars into action as Glitch tries to take a selfie with a lion in the Maasai Mara.
Bike Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.
Mum School Bluey plays mum to a brood of bouncy balloons, including an irrepressible floater named Greenie. But she soon discovers that mothering is much harder than she imagined.
Granny Mobile Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.
Space Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.
Emperor Penguins Andy, Jen and Scout head to Antarctica on a global adventure in search of brown patches on the ice. Along the way, they meet some emperor penguins.
Towel Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!
The Bridge Badge It's bridge building time... the squirrels help a quarrelling group of Gerbils sort out their longstanding disagreement.
The Buddy Badge Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.
The Diplomacy Badge Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.
Puffin Patrol, Iceland The Westman Islands south of Iceland are home to one of the largest colonies of puffins in the world! Once a year puffins return to the land to lay a single egg and they often make their nests in underground burrows.
Go Jet Academy: Symbiosis Shrink Down Tala, Foz and Lars shrink down to insect-size to learn about the friendship between plants and animals, but they find themselves in big trouble when Glitch upsets a colony of ants.
Gordon and Rebecca - Coming Through! Gordon tries to tell Rebecca how to pull the express like he does, but Rebecca proves that her way may not always be as loud or fast, but works just as well.
Fast Slow Bungalow Flamingo and John give Sarah and Duck a tour of their house and invite them to play their favourite game...
Bags of Bags Scarf Lady has misplaced Bag in the Big Shop, so Sarah and Duck help with the search.
Cake Hattie calls up Stanley to help her make a cake. She doesn't have some of the ingredients. Stanley instead makes them using his ingenious contraptions.
Dinosaur The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.
No Kissing In School From feeling nervous and shy, to making a million friends! The funny animals chat about all the things they love about school.
It's Time to Bury a Time Capsule When JoJo, Gran Gran and the Nature Club dig up a buried time capsule, they find it filled with lots of old items that belong to the old club. Gran Gran has a plan: why don't they reunite the capsule's owners with their possessions? Then JoJo and the Nature Club can bury a new time capsule of their own!
Phones Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!
Pavlova Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.
Rain When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.
The Accessory Badge The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.
The Mountain Badge The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.
Eugene's Animal Chorus Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!
The Aqueduct of Segovia Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of it's ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters don't have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

The Face Painting Badge The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.
The Carrot Badge The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.
Ready Or Not Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!
Stick Together Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!
Maasai Mara National Park, Kenya The team roars into action as Glitch tries to take a selfie with a lion in the Maasai Mara.
Bike Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.
Mum School Bluey plays mum to a brood of bouncy balloons, including an irrepressible floater named Greenie. But she soon discovers that mothering is much harder than she imagined.
Granny Mobile Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.
Space Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.
Emperor Penguins Andy, Jen and Scout head to Antarctica on a global adventure in search of brown patches on the ice. Along the way, they meet some emperor penguins.
Towel Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!
The Bridge Badge It's bridge building time... the squirrels help a quarrelling group of Gerbils sort out their longstanding disagreement.
The Buddy Badge Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.
The Diplomacy Badge Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.
Puffin Patrol, Iceland The Westman Islands south of Iceland are home to one of the largest colonies of puffins in the world! Once a year puffins return to the land to lay a single egg and they often make their nests in underground burrows.
Go Jet Academy: Symbiosis Shrink Down Tala, Foz and Lars shrink down to insect-size to learn about the friendship between plants and animals, but they find themselves in big trouble when Glitch upsets a colony of ants.
Gordon and Rebecca - Coming Through! Gordon tries to tell Rebecca how to pull the express like he does, but Rebecca proves that her way may not always be as loud or fast, but works just as well.
Fast Slow Bungalow Flamingo and John give Sarah and Duck a tour of their house and invite them to play their favourite game...
Bags of Bags Scarf Lady has misplaced Bag in the Big Shop, so Sarah and Duck help with the search.
Cake Hattie calls up Stanley to help her make a cake. She doesn't have some of the ingredients. Stanley instead makes them using his ingenious contraptions.
Dinosaur The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.
No Kissing In School From feeling nervous and shy, to making a million friends! The funny animals chat about all the things they love about school.
It's Time to Bury a Time Capsule When JoJo, Gran Gran and the Nature Club dig up a buried time capsule, they find it filled with lots of old items that belong to the old club. Gran Gran has a plan: why don't they reunite the capsule's owners with their possessions? Then JoJo and the Nature Club can bury a new time capsule of their own!
Phones Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!
Pavlova Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.
Rain When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.
The Accessory Badge The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.
The Mountain Badge The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.
Eugene's Animal Chorus Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!
The Aqueduct of Segovia Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of it's ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters don't have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!
Chilli Peppers Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bagpipe playing Chilli Peppers, melting Kiwi backstage and performing their song "We're Chilli When It's Hot!"
Grapefruit Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Grapefruit, dedicating the song "All My Friends" to the close pals who go with her everywhere.

Treasure Trail Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa‐Laa and Po follow a trail of flowers which leads them to some very special treasure.
K Dee encourages a friend to say 'k', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see some kittens, fly some kites and meet a kind kangaroo!

Driving With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.
The Rainbow Badge The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!
The Ambition Badge Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.
Animals The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.
Mount Everest, Asia Kyan wants to climb Mount Everest, but his daring plan is interrupted by Grandmaster Glitch, who's careering down the mountain in a giant snowball.
Chicory Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Chicory running the show backstage and singing about how she, the Belgian Endive, was discovered in the song "Chicory, Dickory, Dock!"
Cauliflower Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Cauliflower creaking away as she grows and sings her catchy "Cauliflower Creak" song.
Cereal Mountain Chilli is determined to make it to the top of Cereal Mountain without the help of Supertato and his gadgets. Evil Pea tries to get there first by cheating.
Dragon Boat Beats It's a special day in the veggie aisle because it's the Dragon Boat Race Festival on Ice. The Supermarket is frozen over and Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Tomato practice for the boat race by using chopsticks for oars, but it doesn't go well as they're out of sync with each other. Tokyo, Ryogoku Kokugikan Show 3 For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Meisei, Tsurugisho, Kotonowaka and Tobizaru.
Wide World of Fights Juan Manuel Marquez vs. Juan Diaz This episode features a lightweight title bout between Juan Manuel Marquez and Juan Diaz, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!
Chael Sonnen, Matt Serra, Clay Guida and more! This episode follows former UFC welterweight champion Matt Serra around his hometown in New Jersey for a look at the lighter side of this intense competitor. Ring girl Natasha Wicks shows us that the fighters aren't the only ones with the big guns. Plus a behind the scenes look at the UFC Fan Expo and an interview with MMA legend Chael Sonnen.

This episode features 'GGG' Gennady Golovkin (23-1, 20 KOs) making his American debut defending his WBA and IBO middleweight world titles against Grzegorz 'Super G' Proska (28-1, 21 KOs). The fight took place at Turning Stone Resort

This episode is highlighted by a heartfelt interview with the legendary MMA Hall of Famer Tito Ortiz that shows you sides of the former champ you never knew from his childhood to his love of fishing to the man he is today. The Prince And The Tickly Torment Prince Ivandoe stumbles across a secret meeting of the Royal Society for the Punishment of Peasants.
The Prince And The Ducky Day For Prince Ivandoe every day feels exactly the same...because it is!!! And he's the only one who can see it.
The Prince And The All-Alone Gnome Hansi, a Sassy Gnome, has been left all alone by his brothers.
The Prince And The Dreamy Ogre Part 1 Prince Ivandoe must enter the feared Underground Kingdom of the Ogres to find a secret pathway.
The Prince And The Dreamy Ogre Part 2 Prince Ivandoe must enter the feared Underground Kingdom of the Ogres to find a secret pathway.
The Prince And The Sassy Skaters Prince Ivandoe has had enough of Goldenlocks' silly, unheroic singing and sends him on his way.
The Prince And The Fraudy Lord When Prince Ivandoe rescues Lord Roderick, they quickly become firm friends. They've so much in common, and even look alike!
The Prince And The Lonely Trollstress Taking shelter from a snowstorm, Prince Ivandoe gets trapped in the home of a Giant Trollstress.
The Prince And The Heroic Hooded Hermit When Prince Ivandoe gets trapped in the Burpy Bog, Bert asks the mysterious Hooded Hermit for help.
The Prince And The Foggy Bog Lady Prince Ivandoe charges off into the foggy swamp to find some turnips but finds the feared Bog Lady instead! Meanwhile Bert gets enchanted by the Queen of the Mist.
The Prince And The Three-Headed Knight When Prince Ivandoe discovers a secret chest, guarded by a three headed knight, he is certain the Golden Feather lies within.
The Prince And The Doomy Loom Of Destiny Prince Ivandoe's heroic destiny is foretold by the Harpy sisters Agatha & Hildr.
The Prince And The Scrawny Squire So close to Eagle Mountain, Ivandoe & Bert get hopelessly trapped by an avalanche. Their thoughts turn to how they first met and started on their Quest.
The Prince And The Valiant Quest Prince Ivandoe and Bert set off on their heroic quest and, almost immediately, a winged serpent steals their map to Eagle Mountain.
The Prince And The Chicken Of Doom A fire-breathing Giant Chicken is destroying the local farmers' prize vegetables. Prince Ivandoe vows to capture the Giant Chicken, but... gets captured by her instead.
The Prince And The Sing-Songy Stag When Prince Ivandoe valiantly sets free Brian the Bard, he discovers he is now stuck with him... until such time that Brian saves Prince Ivandoe's life in return.
The Prince And The Tears Of Triumph In an effort to impress Jezebel the thiefstress, Prince Ivandoe and Bert set off to find the elusive Centicore.
The Prince And The Turnip Tricksters Prince Ivandoe vows to capture the turnip thief... the very worst type of thief!
The Prince And The Swoony Swanstress Prince Ivandoe and Bert take a lovely, but lost and confused, Swanstress under their wing.
The Prince And The Feather Fluffer-Upper Part 1 Prince Ivandoe and Bert reluctantly agree to bring Princess Syllabob, of the Underwater Kingdom, an all-powerful Trident for her Sweet Sixteenth birthday.
The Prince And The Feather Fluffer-Upper Part 2 Prince Ivandoe and Bert reluctantly agree to bring Princess Syllabob, of the Underwater Kingdom, an all-powerful Trident for her Sweet Sixteenth birthday.
The Prince And The Feast Of The Fopdoodles Prince Ivandoe reluctantly accepts an invitation to a Royal MidSwanner Feast.
You Gotta Have A Plan Joyce asks Alex to be the executor of her estate. Matt and Serena are forced to keep watch over a bickering family.
People Just Say Stuff Online Ron's bedside manner earns him a complaint from a frustrated patient. Alex insists an unflattering online review was not about her.
Can't Knock The Hustle The Banks family goes to church; Will considers taking the opportunity to find his father, unknowingly driving a wedge between Phil and Geoffrey.
Where To? Will's father shows up unexpectedly and tells the truth about where he's been, exposing a long-buried lie that the adults have told Will.
Buktu The Future Team Tennyson break inside Area 55 to save Tim Buktu.
Omni-Copped When Grandpa Max's engineer buddy Phil Billings gifts Team Tennyson the Omni-Copter - a state of the art flying vehicle that can transport the Rustbucket for overseas adventures.
This One Goes To 11 During one last stop by a toy store before Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max's maiden voyage across the Atlantic, Ben runs into an old bully, Kevin 11, who now has new powers - able to transform into aliens just like Ben, such as the 'bootleg' doppelgänger of Cannonbolt-- Wreckingbolt!
Moor Fogg Team Tennyson goes international in the Omni-Copter and the first stop is for a hike in the Scottish Highlands, but the weather isn't just bad, it's foggy, and that means one thing and one thing only: the return of The Fogg!
Rath Of Con Back stateside, Ben can't get into a cat cosplay competition, Top Tail, without a costume of his own, but when he goes Rath - a new cat-like alien with an attitude - Ben's newfound wild side quickly becomes much more than he bargained for.
I Wish I Could Get It Back Ruby and her friends embark on a thrilling and unexpected wish adventure close to home.
Take My Life, Please When an 11-year-old 'good witch' comes to Orchid Bay, she manages to do a better job at fighting evil than June.
Meet The Parent Monroe's fun-loving dad, William, comes to visit and criticizes how his son does his job as advisor to the Te Xuan Ze.
Monster Con Every three years, magical creatures from all over the world come together for the Convergence.
Fantastic Beasts And Where To Find Them A Magizoologist arrives in New York amid tensions in the wizarding world only to be branded as a fugitive as he tries to recover his missing beasts.
Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets Of Dumbledore Professor Albus Dumbledore knows the powerful Dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald is moving to seize control of the wizarding world.
King Of The Castle Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max next travel to Castle Bishopbrook to visit a distant relative who's royalty, but when Ben encounters a 'ghost' at the haunted home, it turns out to actually be his new rival, Kevin 11, throwing even more twisted aliens his way: Thornblade, Undertow, and Dark Matter!
Speechless On The Seine While in Paris, France, Ben catches Zombozo robbing the Louvre, but when Zombozo hypnotizes Ben to remain speechless, Ben must navigate a foreign land like a mime in order to stop the criminal clown and his travelling circus.
Poles Apart A trip to the South Pole goes upside down when Team Tennyson lands on the North Pole instead, but Ben quickly discovers the culprits: Solar & Polar Twain, magnetically-powered scientists who want to hold the world ransom by threatening to reverse Earth's magnetic poles!
Show Don't Tell Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max arrive at a Native American national park to witness the Ayasha Plinths - an ancient Stonehenge-like rock formation - but when the sinister sorcerer Hex arrives, Ben must battle against a beast Hex magically made out of huge rocks!
Don't Touch Team Tennyson checks out a Samurai Museum in Tokyo, where Ben is too impatient to wait out the Calligraphy experience for the more exciting-sounding Samurai one, but when a dangerous Samurai sword is stolen from the exhibit, Ben must take on its thief - the new Big Bad in town, the Forever Knight.
I Wish I Could Stop Hurting Ruby sets off to settle a longstanding family feud.
The Prince And The Boasty Boar In an attempt to win the hand of Princess Jezabel, Boaris Von Tusk stages a tournament to prove that he is the greatest warrior in all The Five Kingdoms.
The Prince And The Blobby Princess Princess Syllabob, the blobby daughter of Axalotly, King of the Deep, has been carried off by a gang of gulls and discarded on the forest floor.
The Prince And The Wise Wizard Of Wisdom Struck down by a poisonous turnip, Prince Ivandoe & Bert must seek a cure from the Wise Wizard of Wisdom.
The Prince And The Squeak Of Obedience Feral and her gang of cat-thieves have stolen Prince Ivandoe's map to Eagle Mountain. Cupcake, the pink-poodle survivalist offers to train Prince Ivandoe to become a Jungle Warrior
The Prince And The Princenappers Whilst travelling through the notoriously dangerous Forest of Outlaws, Prince Ivandoe is repeatedly Princenapped!
O Brother What Art Thou Ray-Ray tests a growth potion to make himself bigger, but he becomes a gigantic monster.
It's The Great Pumpkin, Juniper Lee Monster parents asks for June's help when their kids turn into humans beings for Halloween and stay that way.
Hotel For Dogs A teen secretly fills a vacant house with stray dogs after she moves in with her fastidious aunt and has to leave her dog behind.

Anything To Push Zaluva Ron's teasing makes Joyce question whether her friendship with a pharmaceutical rep is genuine.
